author: val
body: Bytes 0 to 63 are the desk's: the window registry keeps a window's slot at cells 44 through 60 of whatever block `desk-wnd-blk` answers, so the service's cells start at 64. A slot is 64 bytes, one length byte and up to 63 of text; sixteen slots is what a pane body shows without scrolling.

author: val
body: 8 MiB: the mux's arena set is 384 KiB and compaction lets 128 KiB of garbage build before it runs, which leaves a plain spawn's 1 MiB heap 512 KiB, eight 64 KiB receive buffers counting the listener's.
